providers.label: Tangem / future WorldzCard
providers.requirement: Use an officially supported and independently reviewed Tangem SDK or handoff; branded card issuance requires separate provider agreement. Never claim NFC signing works until proven on real hardware.

security.keyHandling: Keys, seed phrases, PINs, NFC secrets and hardware credentials never enter Worldz servers, logs, analytics or browser storage.
security.signing: No signing or broadcasting until explicit per-chain user approval, transaction simulation, clear destination/amount/network/fees and independent security review.
security.treasury: Separate personal wallets from treasury accounts; require approved multisignature policy and documented governance. No automatic allocation, transfer or trading.
security.crossChain: No assumption that one hardware card supports every chain or signature scheme; verify support separately.
security.recovery: Explain provider-supported backup and recovery; never collect recovery material.
security.mobile: Android release requires verified package identity, signing, Digital Asset Links, app-link domain ownership and independent penetration testing.

acceptanceGates: Chain-by-chain support and test vectors verified
Android device NFC/handoff integration tested on physical hardware
User-visible simulation and explicit signing confirmation tested
Threat model and independent security assessment completed
No secrets in telemetry or storage verified
Play Store policy, privacy and app-signing review passed
